verdict.rationale: Pylon has a dedicated first-party webhooks page describing user-defined HTTP callbacks triggered by specific events within Pylon. Its bring-your-own-agent docs explicitly name webhooks as a way to connect an agent to ticketing workflows, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: an enumerated event catalog and payload schemas, delivery details (signing/verification, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks are user-defined HTTP callbacks that are triggered by specific events within Pylon.
Receive webhooks for various events happening in Pylon.
Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.
